## Kitsissut: Lethbridge Hut 1

This technical archaeological illustration documents the form and recorded features of Lethbridge Hut 1 at Kitsissut.

[![](images/illustrations/lethbridge-hut-1-final.png){.static-preview .illustration-preview fig-alt="Completed technical archaeological illustration of Lethbridge Hut 1 at Kitsissut"}](images/illustrations/lethbridge-hut-1-final.png){target="_blank"}

::: {.portfolio-actions}
[Open full-size completed illustration](images/illustrations/lethbridge-hut-1-final.png){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}
:::

**My role:** I converted supplied archaeological feature information into a finished vector illustration in Adobe Illustrator.

**Skills demonstrated:** Archaeological interpretation, precise vector linework, feature differentiation, visual hierarchy, labeling, and preparation of publication-quality graphics.

**Source and context:** Produced from archaeological plan data supplied for the Kitsissut research project.
